home.heroTitle: Your Student Life in Korea, Made Easier
home.heroSubtitle: Verified information from the university and Korean government sources, announcements from SCH Global Supporters, and help in your language.
home.latestEmptyBody: Announcements appear here after an administrator has reviewed and approved them.
home.deadlinesEmptyBody: Deadlines from approved announcements will be listed here.

f1.q: Where does the information come from?
f1.a: From official SCH pages, Korean government websites, and announcements submitted by SCH Global Supporters. Every item shows its source and when it was last verified.

f2.q: How do I find information about my situation?
f2.a: Use the search box above or open a category such as Visa & Immigration or Scholarships. Then open the official source link to confirm the details.

f3.q: Is this the official university website?
f3.a: No. This is a student-support project. Always confirm important decisions with the official source linked on each page or with the relevant university office.

f4.q: Can I read announcements in my language?
f4.a: The original Korean text is always shown. Translations appear only after a human reviewer has approved them.

f5.q: Who can I ask for help?
f5.a: Visit the Student Support page to see how to reach the international office and SCH Global Supporters.

home.faqNote: These answers are general guidance only. They do not replace official regulations or deadlines.
